title: Measure Appointment Allowances and Fees — Window Replacement Contracts
content:
# Measure Appointment Allowances and Fees

Field operations schedule for Window Replacement Contracts: each Ridgeline series sets the measure booking window, the reschedule notice, the missed appointments waived, the missed-appointment fee, the free customer-requested remeasures and the remeasure fee.

| Series | Measure offered within (business days after deposit complete) | Reschedule notice for an on-time reschedule (hours) | Missed appointments waived per contract | Missed-appointment fee | Free customer-requested remeasures per contract | Remeasure fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl | 10 | 24 | 1 | $75.00 | 0 | $125.00 |
| Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl | 10 | 24 | 1 | $75.00 | 1 | $125.00 |
| Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl | 8 | 24 | 1 | $85.00 | 1 | $135.00 |
| Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite | 8 | 24 | 1 | $95.00 | 1 | $150.00 |
| Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | 7 | 24 | 1 | $95.00 | 2 | $150.00 |
| Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | 7 | 24 | 1 | $125.00 | 2 | $175.00 |

## Points of judgement on the schedule

- The booking window is counted in business days after the deposit is received in full.
- The notice figure is the minimum number of hours before an appointment's start at which a customer reschedule still counts as on time rather than late.
- The waived figure and the free-remeasure figure are counts per contract. A free-remeasure count of 0 means a customer-requested remeasure carries the remeasure fee from the first one.
- The missed-appointment fee is charged for each missed appointment beyond the waived count; the remeasure fee is the series figure for a customer-requested remeasure beyond the free count.
